findings.title: Owner row 8 (and the M2 / section 6 lists it cites) still count six 0603 resistors with a fan-out via under the body; on 92c3ad59 there are five, R403's via was removed by D-R24-09
findings.contradicts: docs/R10_VALIDATION.md owner decision table row 8 (bound to PCB 92c3ad59): 'six 0603 resistors with a fanout via under the body ... (table and list in section 6)'; section 6 R19-RTE-04 'Six 0603 resistors ... R403 F(31.4,14.4) GND via between PORT_LDO_FB / GND', marked 'recorded (owner M2 list)'; docs/REQUIREMENTS.md M2 'the six 0603 fan-out vias under R86, R89, R91, R101, R401 and R403'. Against D-R24-09 (R10_DECISIONS; R10_VALIDATION line 2002-2003; AVA_LAYOUT round 24 table): R403 moved to B(30.9,14.6) and its return via (31.4,14.4) was removed.
findings.evidence: pcbnew dump of m3_design/assembly_review/m3.kicad_pcb (92c3ad59): R403 is B(30.9,14.6) rot 180, pads R403.1 PORT_LDO_FB (31.725,14.6) and R403.2 GND (30.075,14.6); no via lies within 0.9 mm of its body, and no via exists at (31.4,14.4). R403.2 returns on B.Cu (30.075,14.6)-(29.575,14.1)-(28.75,14.1) to U401.4. A scan of every 2-pad part for a via between its pad centres (lateral offset < 0.45 mm) finds exactly five 0603 resistors: R86 GND (27.9,64.25), R89 3V3 (23.0,70.0), R91 3V3 (28.1,60.0), R101 CAM_UART_OE (34.0,42.0), R401 GND (13.0,1.8). The same scan on a3144b15 (acba196) and 5516eeec (9b27268) finds six, R403 (31.4,14.4) included. Probe: .supervisor/r26_routing/underbody.py on geo.json / geo_old.json / geo_5516.json.
findings.impact: The owner is asked to accept a deviation instance that no longer exists, and the current count in the acceptance row is wrong.
findings.concrete_fix: Row 8: 'five 0603 resistors with a fanout via under the body (R86, R89, R91, R101, R401; R403's went with D-R24-09)'. In section 6 R19-RTE-04 add 'R403's via (31.4,14.4) was removed by D-R24-09 on 1407e850; five remain'; in REQUIREMENTS M2 name the five (or say 'six on a3144b15, five since D-R24-09').

findings.title: Section 6 layer-change returns: '12 of the 21 are beyond 4 mm' is 13 by the metric that reproduces every other figure in the sentence
findings.contradicts: docs/R10_VALIDATION.md section 6 'Layer-change returns (R18-RTE-02)': 'The nearest rail-to-GND capacitor is 1.29-6.19 mm away (SD_MISO 6.19 mm, SD_SCK 5.33, SD_MOSI 5.07, SD_CS 4.84, all to C17; SPI1 5.04-5.77; QSPI_NCS 5.32; 12 of the 21 are beyond 4 mm)'.
findings.evidence: For the 21 required critical-signal vias over an In2 power rail (3V3 x17, PORT_4V8 x4, In2 net sampled 0.75 mm round each via), distance from the via centre to the rail-side pad centre of the nearest capacitor joining that rail to GND: QSPI_IO3 1.29 (C29), QSPI_CLK 1.50 (C100), SD_DAT2 1.89 (C461), QSPI_IO0 2.13, QSPI_IO1 2.17 (C16), RADIO_RX_MCU 2.97 (C411), QSPI_IO2 3.13 (C17), GPS_TX_MCU 3.21 (C410), then CAM_MCU_RX 4.02 (C29.1 (28.0,43.1) from via (32.0,43.5); C29.2 4.024), CAM_MCU_TX 4.21, GPS_RX_MCU 4.33 (C406.1), SD_CS 4.84, IMU_CS 4.85, SPI1_MOSI 5.04, SD_MOSI 5.07, RADIO_TX_MCU 5.12, QSPI_NCS 5.32, SD_SCK 5.33, SPI1_SCK 5.63, SPI1_MISO 5.77, SD_MISO 6.19. Every figure the sentence quotes reproduces exactly (range 1.29-6.19, the four SD values, SPI1 5.04-5.77, QSPI_NCS 5.32, RADIO_TX 5.12 in round18_routing.md); 13 are beyond 4 mm. The centre-to-centre metric gives 12 but then SD_MISO is 6.10, not 6.19. Same result on a3144b15 (the round 18 board; via and capacitor positions unchanged). Probe: .supervisor/r26_routing/caps.py, caps_old.py, in2.py.
findings.impact: A wrong count in an owner-facing deviation record (the row 8 return-path item); also repeated in the round 18 ledger row R18-m21.
findings.concrete_fix: Change '12 of the 21' to '13 of the 21' in section 6 (and in the R18-m21 row), or state that CAM_MCU_RX sits at 4.02 mm.

findings.title: AUX_TX_WIRE / AUX_RX_WIRE change layer through J440.3 / J440.4 with no GND via within 1.5 mm (3.900 / 4.037 mm), although D-R19-15 keeps the port UART nets under the 1.5 mm partner-via rule; route_check only tests vias, so it passes
findings.contradicts: AGENTS.md section 3 ('a GND via within 1.5 mm (centre to centre) of every layer change of a critical signal net'); R10_DECISIONS D-R19-15 (R19-REQ-10): 'Decision: the GPS / RADIO / AUX / CAM port UART nets stay under the stricter 1.5 mm GND-partner-via and one-In2-region rules ... the frozen board meets them' (also tools/critical_reference.py comment above R10_SLOW_RETURN_NETS and M3_R10 'the port UARTs stay under the strict return-path rules'); REQUIREMENTS M2 names route_check --profile r10 as the R10 gate, whose R10_CLASSES put AUX_(TX|RX)_WIRE in class 'uart' (SIGNAL_CRITICAL, return_required true). New against the round 24 / 25 triage observation, which judged AUX 'not critical in AGENTS section 3' without D-R19-15.
findings.evidence: Board 92c3ad59: AUX_TX_WIRE runs F.Cu R471.2 (15.275,18.0) -> J440.3 (7.4,18.0) and B.Cu J440.3 -> (4.81,18.0) -> (4.45,18.36) -> D440.1 (4.45,19.125); AUX_RX_WIRE runs F.Cu R470.1 (15.275,20.6) -> (12.4,20.6) -> (11.5,21.5) -> J440.4 (7.4,21.5) and B.Cu J440.4 -> (4.81,21.5) -> (4.45,21.86) -> D441.1 (4.45,22.725). The plated pins are the only F.Cu-B.Cu transition of each net (no vias on either net). Nearest GND via centre: 3.900 mm from J440.3, 4.037 mm from J440.4 (pcbnew, .supervisor/r26_routing/tht.py). Every other port pin (J410.3/.4, J420.3/.4, J9.3/.4) carries one layer only. route_check --profile r10 on the board: 0 failing; its critical_via_no_gnd examines PCB_VIA items only ('a via carrying a critical signal net's copper on >= 2 layers'), so a plated pad used as the layer change is never tested. The layer change appeared with D-R20-09 (D440 / D441 moved under J440 on B.Cu, 0dc84776); on 50a39de5 the AUX pair was F.Cu only (M3_R10 'no layer change'), which is when D-R19-15 said the board meets the rule.
findings.impact: Two instances of the rule the R10 records keep blocking for port UARTs, not listed as a deviation; D-R19-15's 'the frozen board meets them' is false since D-R20-09; the gate cannot see a plated-pad layer change on any critical signal net.
findings.concrete_fix: Either put both J440 runs on B.Cu from R470 / R471 (as at J410 / J420; the layer change then moves to a via that can take a GND partner), or record the two pin layer changes as an owner deviation with a reason (or add AUX wire nets to an explicit, reasoned exemption). In route_check, count a plated pad that carries one critical signal net's tracks on two copper layers as a layer change for critical_via_no_gnd.
